correctness.rationale: The three-rule CNF grammar generates only x1 x1', which is the identity in the free group. Under the source's U=Sigma^* x T definition, the closure recurrence places <x1 x1',e> in g^4_14; this is distinct from <epsilon,e> because the first coordinate is a free-monoid word. The line-7 test therefore rejects a true inclusion. The calculation was also reproduced by a standalone exact verifier.

value.rationale: The example directly refutes the central correctness equivalence and algorithm on only three nonterminals and a free group, while isolating the exact distinction between literal free-monoid equality and equality in the target group that any repair must address.
